hero_kpi_rationale: Orders received are the main forward demand indicator in Atlas Copco's industrial model, reflecting customer investment health in industrial equipment and sustainable solutions, a key growth driver.

kpis.signal: Slight order decline in 2025, signaling moderate industrial demand slowdown
Revenue down in 2025, reflecting a challenging industrial environment.

kpis.explanation_en: Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation and Amortization.
kpis.signal: EBITDA down, reflecting volume pressure and operating leverage

kpis.explanation_en: EBITDA Margin — EBITDA divided by revenue.
kpis.signal: EBITDA margin slightly compressed despite the difficult context, evidencing good cost control
Operating margin compression in 2025 reflecting the impact of lower volumes
EBITA significantly down, reflecting pressure on fixed costs and volume drop

kpis.explanation_en: Operating Cash Flow — cash generated from core business operations.
kpis.signal: Operating cash flow notably down, reflecting pressure on profitability
EBITA margin under pressure, reflecting operating deleverage tied to volume drop.

kpis.explanation_en: Return on Capital Employed — operating profit divided by capital employed.
Revenue from the Compressor Technique segment.
Revenue from the Industrial Technique segment.
Revenue from the Power Technique segment.
Dividend Per Share — total dividends paid divided by shares outstanding.
kpis.signal: Dividend cut risk, monitor payout sustainability

kpis.explanation_en: Capital Return — total cash returned to shareholders (dividends + buybacks).
Payout Ratio — dividends paid divided by net income.
kpis.signal: Shareholder returns growing, dividend policy supportive

ai_positioning.summary: Atlas Copco does not appear as a generative AI leader, but gradually integrates digital and automation technologies into its industrial solutions. The focus is on efficiency.
